lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in an irregular grid of approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes on the lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish are visible swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral region of the whale shark.
